name: Kazimierz Lewandowski
bio:
Kazimierz has been turning wrenches since he was a teenager, initially apprenticing at a tractor repair shop in rural Poland. His meticulous nature and innate understanding of mechanical systems soon led him to automotive engineering. He joined a small rally team in the late 90s, traveling across Europe and learning the ropes of high-pressure motorsport. Kazimierz's approach is one of unwavering precision. He believes in doing things right the first time, always double-checking his work and maintaining an organized workspace.

After several years with the rally team, he moved to Belgium and joined Boutsen VDS, drawn by their commitment to innovation and their collaborative environment. He thrives on the challenges of crafting and maintaining high-performance racing machinery, and his colleagues value his practical solutions and calm demeanor under pressure. Kazimierz brings a wealth of old-school experience combined with a willingness to embrace new technologies, making him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.description: A stout man with a weathered face and kind eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with technical diagrams and handwritten notes.
Has a habit of humming Polish folk songs while working on intricate engine components.
Insists on cleaning his tools with a specific brand of Polish-made oil.
